## penguins

```{r}
library(palmerpenguins)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)

penguins

# select wanted data
best_penguins <- penguins[, c("species", "body_mass_g", "flipper_length_mm")] |>
  filter(species == "Chinstrap") |>
drop_na()

# correlation between sex and bodymass
cor_penguins <- cor( x = best_penguins$body_mass_g, 
       y = best_penguins$flipper_length_mm, 
       use = "pairwise.complete" 
    ) 
```

```{r}
model1 <- lm(species ~ body_mass_g, data = best_penguins)
```
